column2: Diagnostics copied. Paste them to the developer, or select Report a problem to open a GitHub issue.

column1: 无法复制诊断信息，请稍后重试。
column2: Could not copy diagnostics. Try again later.

column1: 已复制诊断信息并打开 GitHub。登录后在问题描述里按 Ctrl+V 粘贴即可提交。
column2: Diagnostics copied and GitHub opened. Sign in, then press Ctrl+V in the description to paste them.

column1: 已打开 GitHub，但诊断信息复制失败。请先点「复制诊断信息」，再粘贴到问题描述里。
column2: GitHub opened, but diagnostics could not be copied. Select Copy diagnostics, then paste them into the description.

column1: 无法打开浏览器。诊断信息已复制，可以直接粘贴发给开发者。
column2: Could not open the browser. Diagnostics are copied; paste them to the developer.

column1: 无法打开浏览器，也无法复制诊断信息，请稍后重试。
column2: Could not open the browser or copy diagnostics. Try again later.

column1: 未找到 Apple 设备连接组件。点「安装连接组件」即可自动安装。
column2: Apple connection components were not found. Select Install Apple support to install them.

column1: Apple Mobile Device Service 已被禁用，常见于系统优化软件。点「修复连接服务」并在 Windows 弹窗中点「是」，CopiaGo 会把它改回自动启动并启动它。
column2: Apple Mobile Device Service is disabled, often by a system optimizer. Select Repair connection service and choose Yes in the Windows prompt. CopiaGo sets it back to automatic and starts it.

column1: Apple Mobile Device Service 没有运行。点「修复连接服务」并在 Windows 弹窗中点「是」，CopiaGo 会启动它并恢复为随 Windows 自动启动（Apple 的默认设置）。
column2: Apple Mobile Device Service is not running. Select Repair connection service and choose Yes in the Windows prompt. CopiaGo starts it and sets it back to start with Windows (Apple's default).

column1: 端口 27015 被「{program}」占用，Apple 连接服务无法工作。请退出该程序（或在任务管理器中结束它），然后点「修复连接服务」。
column2: Port 27015 is used by {program}, so the Apple connection service cannot work. Quit that program (or end it in Task Manager), then select Repair connection service.

column1: Apple Mobile Device Service 没有响应。点「修复连接服务」并在 Windows 弹窗中点「是」，CopiaGo 会重启它；仍不行请重启电脑。
column2: Apple Mobile Device Service is not responding. Select Repair connection service and choose Yes in the Windows prompt to restart it. If that fails, restart your PC.

column1: 未找到 Apple Mobile Device Service。请点「安装连接组件」重新安装。
column2: Apple Mobile Device Service was not found. Select Install Apple support to reinstall it.

column1: USB 连接超时。请把 iPhone 直接插在电脑机身的 USB 口（不要经过扩展坞或延长线），保持解锁，再点「继续连接」。
column2: USB timed out. Plug your iPhone directly into a USB port on the PC (no hub or extension), keep it unlocked, then select Continue.

column1: 与 iPhone 的连接中断。请插紧数据线并保持手机解锁，再点「继续连接」；反复断开时请换一个 USB 口或数据线。
column2: The iPhone connection ended. Seat the cable firmly, keep the phone unlocked, then select Continue. If it keeps dropping, try another USB port or cable.

column1: 打开 iPhone「设置 → 隐私与安全性」，在底部找到「开发者模式」并打开，按提示重启。重启后解锁，在弹窗中点「打开」，再点下方按钮。若仍没有该开关，可能是公司或学校管理的设备。
column2: Open Settings → Privacy & Security on your iPhone, turn on Developer Mode near the bottom, and restart when prompted. Unlock it, tap Turn On, then continue below. If the switch is missing, the phone may be managed by a company or school.

column1: CopiaGo 需要 iOS 17 或更高版本，这台 iPhone 的系统版本过低。请在 iPhone「设置 → 通用 → 软件更新」升级后，再点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: CopiaGo needs iOS 17 or later, and this iPhone runs an older version. Update it in Settings → General → Software Update, then select Connect iPhone.

column1: 正在修复 Apple USB 驱动，请完成 Windows 管理员授权。
column2: Repairing the Apple USB driver. Approve the Windows administrator prompt.

column1: 修复 Apple 驱动
column2: Repair Apple driver

column1: 电脑检测到了 iPhone，但 Apple 的 USB 驱动没有正常工作。修复将请求管理员权限，为这台电脑重新安装 Apple 自带的驱动。
column2: Windows sees your iPhone, but the Apple USB driver is not working. Repair requires administrator permission and reinstalls the driver that came with Apple Mobile Device Support.

column1: 没有找到 Apple 自带的 USB 驱动文件。请点「安装连接组件」重新安装 Apple Mobile Device Support。
column2: The Apple USB driver files were not found. Select Install Apple support to reinstall Apple Mobile Device Support.

column1: 电脑没有检测到 iPhone。请确认数据线能传输数据（有些线只能充电），把手机直接插在电脑机身的 USB 口并解锁，然后点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Windows does not see an iPhone. Use a cable that carries data (some only charge), plug the phone directly into the PC, unlock it, then select Connect iPhone.

column1: 电脑检测到了 iPhone，但 Apple 的 USB 驱动没有正常工作。点「修复 Apple 驱动」并在 Windows 弹窗中点「是」即可自动修复。
column2: Windows sees your iPhone, but the Apple USB driver is not working. Select Repair Apple driver and choose Yes in the Windows prompt to fix it.

column1: 电脑检测到了 iPhone，但还不能和它通信。请解锁 iPhone 并停留在主屏幕，手机上出现「要信任此电脑吗」时点「信任」，然后点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Windows sees your iPhone but cannot talk to it yet. Unlock it and stay on the Home Screen, tap Trust if asked, then select Connect iPhone.

column1: 等待 iPhone 连接。电脑正在使用 VPN 或代理虚拟网卡「{adapter}」，它可能拦截局域网连接；如果一直连不上，请暂时关闭它或开启局域网直连，并确认手机和电脑在同一 Wi-Fi。
column2: Waiting for iPhone. This PC is using the VPN or proxy adapter {adapter}, which can block local network connections. If it never connects, turn it off or allow direct LAN access, and make sure the phone and PC share the same Wi-Fi.

column1: Apple USB 驱动仍未正常工作。请重新插拔数据线后再点「修复 Apple 驱动」；仍不行请重启电脑，或点「手动下载安装」重新安装 Apple 组件。
column2: The Apple USB driver still is not working. Reconnect the cable and select Repair Apple driver again. If that fails, restart your PC, or select Download manually to reinstall Apple components.

column1: Apple 连接服务仍不可用。请重启电脑后再试；仍不行请点「手动下载安装」重新安装 Apple 组件。
column2: The Apple connection service is still unavailable. Restart your PC and try again. If that fails, select Download manually to reinstall Apple components.

column1: iPhone 已锁定，解锁后会自动重新连接。
column2: iPhone is locked. It reconnects automatically once unlocked.

column1: 已取消管理员授权，未修复 Apple USB 驱动。需要时请再点「修复 Apple 驱动」并在 Windows 弹窗中点「是」；不知道管理员密码请联系电脑管理员。
column2: Administrator permission was cancelled, so the driver was not repaired. Select Repair Apple driver again and choose Yes. If you do not know the administrator password, contact the PC administrator.

column1: 已取消管理员授权，未修复 Apple 连接服务。需要时请再点「修复连接服务」并在 Windows 弹窗中点「是」；不知道管理员密码请联系电脑管理员。
column2: Administrator permission was cancelled, so the service was not repaired. Select Repair connection service again and choose Yes. If you do not know the administrator password, contact the PC administrator.

column1: 已在浏览器中从 apple.com 下载 iTunes（约 200 MB，内含 Apple 设备连接组件）。安装完成后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Downloading iTunes from apple.com in your browser (about 200 MB; it includes Apple device connection components). After installing it, come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 已打开 Microsoft Store。请安装「Apple Devices」，装好后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Microsoft Store is open. Install Apple Devices, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 手动下载安装
column2: Download manually

column1: 无法启动修复。请重启电脑后再试；仍不行请点「手动下载安装」重新安装 Apple 组件。
column2: Could not start the repair. Restart your PC and try again. If that fails, select Download manually to reinstall Apple components.

column1: 无法打开下载页面。请在浏览器中访问 apple.com/itunes/download/win64 下载并安装 iTunes，然后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Could not open the download page. Visit apple.com/itunes/download/win64 in your browser, install iTunes, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 无法连接电脑上的 Apple 设备连接服务（与手机和数据线无关）。
column2: Cannot reach the Apple connection service on this PC (not a phone or cable problem).

column1: Windows 尚未返回修复结果。如果看到管理员授权提示，请批准或取消。
column2: Windows has not finished the repair. If an administrator prompt is open, approve or cancel it.

column1: 没有获得管理员权限，无法修复。请用管理员账户登录 Windows 后再试；公司或学校的电脑请联系管理员。
column2: Administrator rights were not granted, so nothing was repaired. Sign in to Windows with an administrator account and try again. On a work or school PC, contact the administrator.

column1: 电脑上的 Apple 设备连接服务不可用，暂时无法通过数据线连接（不影响 Wi-Fi 连接）。需要修复时，请在设置的 iPhone 卡片上点「继续连接」，再按提示操作。
column2: The Apple connection service on this PC is unavailable, so USB connections do not work for now (Wi-Fi is not affected). To repair it, select Continue on the iPhone card in Settings and follow the prompts.

column1: 自动安装没有完成（可能是网络问题，或取消了管理员授权）。请点「手动下载安装」，装好后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Automatic installation did not finish (a network problem, or administrator permission was cancelled). Select Download manually, install the components, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 这台电脑没有可用的 Windows 包管理器（winget），无法自动安装。请点「手动下载安装」，装好后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: This PC has no working Windows Package Manager (winget), so automatic installation is not possible. Select Download manually, install the components, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 未找到 Apple 设备连接组件，而且这台电脑没有 Windows 包管理器（winget），无法自动安装。请点「手动下载安装」，装好后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Apple connection components were not found, and this PC has no Windows Package Manager (winget) to install them automatically. Select Download manually, install the components, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: iPhone 的开发者模式没有开启。请在 iPhone「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式」中打开并按提示重启，解锁后点「继续连接」。如果「设置」里找不到这个开关，请用数据线连接并解锁 iPhone，再点「继续连接」，CopiaGo 会让它出现。
column2: Developer Mode is off on your iPhone. Turn it on in Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode, restart when prompted, unlock the iPhone and select Continue. If the switch is not in Settings, connect the iPhone by USB, unlock it and select Continue, and CopiaGo will make it appear.

column1: iPhone 的开发者模式没有开启，CopiaGo 也没能让「设置」里出现这个开关。请在 iPhone「设置 → 隐私与安全性」底部查找「开发者模式」并打开；如果没有，请保持手机解锁，重新插拔数据线后点「继续连接」。
column2: Developer Mode is off on your iPhone, and CopiaGo could not make its switch appear in Settings. Look for Developer Mode at the bottom of Settings > Privacy & Security and turn it on. If it is not there, keep the iPhone unlocked, reconnect the USB cable and select Continue.

column1: 电脑检测到了 iPhone，但它在 Windows 中被禁用了。请打开「设备管理器」，在「通用串行总线设备」或「便携设备」下找到 Apple 设备，右键选「启用设备」，然后点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Windows sees your iPhone, but the device is disabled. Open Device Manager, find the Apple device under Universal Serial Bus devices or Portable Devices, right-click it and select Enable device, then select Connect iPhone.

column1: 未找到 USB 连接的 iPhone。请确认手机已用数据线连接并解锁，然后点「连接 iPhone」；仍不行请重新插拔数据线或重启电脑。
column2: No iPhone found on USB. Make sure it is connected by cable and unlocked, then select Connect iPhone. If that does not help, reconnect the cable or restart your PC.

column1: 这是隔离测试实例（设置了 ICB_INSTANCE_NAMESPACE），不会安装或修复 Apple 组件。请用正常启动的 CopiaGo 操作。
column2: This is an isolated test instance (ICB_INSTANCE_NAMESPACE is set), so it does not install or repair Apple components. Use a normally started CopiaGo instead.

column1: 正在打开 Apple Devices…
column2: Opening Apple Devices…

column1: 这台电脑使用 Microsoft Store 版 Apple Devices，它的设备连接进程没有运行。打开 Apple Devices 即可启动它，不需要管理员权限，也不需要另外安装组件。
column2: This PC uses the Microsoft Store edition of Apple Devices, and its device connection process is not running. Opening Apple Devices starts it. No administrator rights or extra components are needed.

column1: 打开 Apple Devices
column2: Open Apple Devices

column1: 已安装 Microsoft Store 版 Apple Devices，但它的设备连接进程没有运行（刚安装、还没打开过时常见）。点「打开 Apple Devices」启动它，看到 Apple Devices 窗口后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: The Microsoft Store edition of Apple Devices is installed, but its device connection process is not running (common right after installing it, before it was ever opened). Select Open Apple Devices, and once its window appears, come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: Microsoft Store 版 Apple Devices 的设备连接进程没有响应。请在任务管理器中结束「AppleMobileDeviceProcess」，再点「打开 Apple Devices」；仍不行请重启电脑。
column2: The device connection process of the Microsoft Store edition of Apple Devices is not responding. End AppleMobileDeviceProcess in Task Manager, then select Open Apple Devices. If that does not help, restart your PC.

column1: 端口 27015 被「{program}」占用，Apple Devices 无法工作。请退出该程序（或在任务管理器中结束它），然后点「打开 Apple Devices」。
column2: Port 27015 is used by {program}, so Apple Devices cannot work. Quit that program (or end it in Task Manager), then select Open Apple Devices.

column1: Apple Devices 已打开，但它的设备连接进程仍未就绪。请稍等片刻再点「连接 iPhone」；仍不行请在任务管理器中结束「AppleMobileDeviceProcess」后重新打开 Apple Devices，或重启电脑。
column2: Apple Devices is open, but its device connection process is not ready yet. Wait a moment, then select Connect iPhone. If that does not help, end AppleMobileDeviceProcess in Task Manager and open Apple Devices again, or restart your PC.

column1: 这台电脑使用 Microsoft Store 版 Apple Devices，没有可修复的系统服务。请点「打开 Apple Devices」，然后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: This PC uses the Microsoft Store edition of Apple Devices, which has no system service to repair. Select Open Apple Devices, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 无法自动打开 Apple Devices。请从开始菜单打开「Apple Devices」，然后回到这里点「连接 iPhone」。
column2: Could not open Apple Devices automatically. Open Apple Devices from the Start menu, then come back and select Connect iPhone.

column1: 等待下一次自动重试
column2: Waiting for the next automatic retry

column1: 正在重新连接…
column2: Reconnecting…

column1: 当前 Wi-Fi 中未发现这台 iPhone。请确认手机已解锁、与电脑连接同一 Wi-Fi 且未开启 VPN；手机回到网络后会自动连接。
column2: This iPhone was not found on the current Wi-Fi. Make sure it is unlocked, on the same Wi-Fi as this PC, and not using a VPN. It reconnects automatically when it is back on the network.

column1: 已在 Wi-Fi 中发现 iPhone，但电脑连不上它。当前网络可能禁止设备互相访问（校园网、公司网和公共 Wi-Fi 常见），请改用手机热点、电脑热点或数据线连接。
column2: The iPhone was found on Wi-Fi, but this PC cannot reach it. The network may block devices from talking to each other (common on campus, corporate, and public Wi-Fi). Use the phone's hotspot, a PC hotspot, or a cable instead.

column1: 电脑无法在局域网中搜索 iPhone，USB 也未检测到它。请把手机直接接到电脑后重试；仍不行请重启电脑。
column2: This PC cannot search the local network for the iPhone, and it was not found over USB. Plug the phone directly into the PC and retry; if that fails, restart the PC.

column1: 已在 Wi-Fi 中发现 iPhone，但电脑连不上它，USB 也未检测到它。当前网络可能禁止设备互相访问，请把手机接到电脑，或改用手机热点后重试。
column2: The iPhone was found on Wi-Fi, but this PC cannot reach it, and it was not found over USB. The network may block devices from talking to each other. Plug the phone into the PC, or switch to the phone's hotspot and retry.

column1: iPhone 未通过这台电脑的无线配对验证，USB 也未检测到它。请在设置中点「忘记此 iPhone」，再用数据线重新配对。
column2: The iPhone rejected this PC's wireless pairing check, and it was not found over USB. Select Forget this iPhone in Settings, then pair again with a cable.

column1: 电脑无法在局域网中搜索 iPhone。请重启电脑后重试；也可以先用数据线连接。
column2: This PC cannot search the local network for the iPhone. Restart the PC and retry, or connect with a cable for now.

column1: 已在 Wi-Fi 中发现 iPhone，但它拒绝了连接。请解锁手机，稍后会自动重试；反复出现时请重启 iPhone。
column2: The iPhone was found on Wi-Fi but refused the connection. Unlock it; CopiaGo retries automatically. If this keeps happening, restart the iPhone.

column1: 已连上 iPhone，但无线握手超时。网络可能不稳定，请让手机靠近路由器并保持解锁，稍后会自动重试。
column2: Reached the iPhone, but the wireless handshake timed out. The network may be unstable. Keep the phone unlocked and near the router; CopiaGo retries automatically.

column1: iPhone 未通过这台电脑的无线配对验证，可能已在手机上取消信任。可先插上数据线使用；若反复出现，请在设置中点「忘记此 iPhone」后重新配对。
column2: The iPhone rejected this PC's wireless pairing check; trust may have been removed on the phone. You can use a cable for now. If this keeps happening, select Forget this iPhone in Settings and pair again.

column1: 已连上 iPhone，但无线加密通道未能建立。请保持手机解锁，稍后会自动重试；反复出现时请重启 iPhone 或改用数据线。
column2: Reached the iPhone, but the encrypted wireless tunnel could not be opened. Keep the phone unlocked; CopiaGo retries automatically. If this keeps happening, restart the iPhone or use a cable.

column1: 已连上 iPhone，但未能读取手机提供的服务。请保持手机解锁，稍后会自动重试；反复出现时请重启 iPhone。
column2: Reached the iPhone, but could not read the services it provides. Keep the phone unlocked; CopiaGo retries automatically. If this keeps happening, restart the iPhone.

column1: 已连上 iPhone，但剪贴板服务未能启动。请保持手机解锁，稍后会自动重试。
column2: Reached the iPhone, but its clipboard service did not start. Keep the phone unlocked; CopiaGo retries automatically.

column1: 无法读取电脑上保存的配对信息。请在设置中点「忘记此 iPhone」后重新配对。
column2: Could not read the pairing saved on this PC. Select Forget this iPhone in Settings and pair again.

column1: 与 iPhone 的连接已断开，正在自动重新连接。若长时间未恢复，请解锁手机并确认与电脑在同一 Wi-Fi，或插上数据线。
column2: The connection to the iPhone was lost. Reconnecting automatically. If it does not recover, unlock the phone and make sure it is on the same Wi-Fi as this PC, or connect a cable.

column1: USB 已检测不到这台 iPhone。请检查数据线是否插紧，稍后会自动重试。
column2: This iPhone is no longer detected over USB. Check that the cable is firmly connected; CopiaGo retries automatically.

column1: USB 连接超时，稍后会自动重试。请把 iPhone 直接插在电脑机身的 USB 口并保持解锁。
column2: The USB connection timed out; CopiaGo retries automatically. Plug the iPhone directly into a USB port on the PC and keep it unlocked.

column1: 已通过 USB 找到 iPhone，但开发者通道未能打开，稍后会自动重试；反复出现时请重新插拔数据线。
column2: Found the iPhone over USB, but the developer channel did not open. CopiaGo retries automatically; if this keeps happening, reconnect the cable.

column1: 已通过 USB 找到 iPhone，但 USB 会话未能建立，稍后会自动重试；反复出现时请重新插拔数据线。
column2: Found the iPhone over USB, but the USB session could not be started. CopiaGo retries automatically; if this keeps happening, reconnect the cable.

column1: USB 信任已失效。请解锁 iPhone 后点「继续连接」，并在手机上点「信任」。
column2: USB trust is no longer valid. Unlock the iPhone, select Continue, then tap Trust on the phone.

column1: 电脑上复制了{kind}，但设置中未开启「{kind}」同步到 iPhone。如需同步，请在设置的「自动同步到 iPhone」中勾选「{kind}」
column2: {kind} copied on this PC, but syncing {kind} to iPhone is turned off. To sync it, select {kind} under Auto-sync to iPhone in Settings.

column1: 正在发送{kind}到 iPhone…
column2: Sending {kind} to iPhone…

column1: 前面还有内容在发送，暂时无法加入。请稍后再点「发送」
column2: Other items are still being sent. Select Send again in a moment.

column1: 图片过大（超过 64 MB），无法发送到 iPhone。请缩小或裁剪图片后重新复制
column2: The image is too large to send to iPhone (over 64 MB). Resize or crop it, then copy it again.

column1: 这张图片无法转换为 PNG，未发送到 iPhone。请用「画图」等程序另存为 PNG 或 JPG 后重新复制
column2: This image could not be converted to PNG and was not sent to iPhone. Save it as PNG or JPG in an app such as Paint, then copy it again.

column1: 已收到「{name}」，但无法放进电脑剪贴板：剪贴板可能被其他程序占用，请稍后在历史中重新复制
column2: Received {name}, but it could not be placed on the PC clipboard. Another app may be using the clipboard; copy it again from history later.

column1: 同步「{name}」超时：手机长时间没有传来数据。请保持手机解锁后重新复制
column2: Syncing {name} timed out: the phone stopped sending data. Keep the phone unlocked and copy it again.

column1: iPhone 没有提供「{name}」的内容。若文件在 iCloud 中，请先在「文件」App 下载到本机
column2: The iPhone did not provide the contents of {name}. If the file is in iCloud, download it in the Files app first.

column1: 还有一个文件正在同步，请等它完成后再试
column2: Another file is still syncing. Try again when it finishes.

column1: 无法把「{name}」保存到电脑，请检查磁盘空间和临时文件夹权限
column2: Could not save {name} on this PC. Check free disk space and access to the temporary folder.

column1: 「{name}」传输不完整，已丢弃。请重新复制一次
column2: {name} arrived incomplete and was discarded. Copy it again.

column1: 「{name}」的格式无法同步。可在 iPhone「文件」App 中长按它选择「压缩」，再复制生成的 zip 文件
column2: The format of {name} cannot be synced. In the Files app on iPhone, touch and hold it, choose Compress, then copy the zip file.

column1: 向 iPhone 请求「{name}」失败，请重新复制一次
column2: Requesting {name} from iPhone failed. Copy it again.

column1: 这台电脑缺少 HEIC 照片解码组件，未能写入。请在 Microsoft Store 安装「HEIF 图像扩展」和「HEVC 视频扩展」，或在 iPhone「设置 → 相机 → 格式」选「兼容性最佳」
column2: This PC cannot decode HEIC photos, so the image was not written. Install HEIF Image Extensions and HEVC Video Extensions from the Microsoft Store, or set iPhone Settings → Camera → Formats to Most Compatible.

column1: 图片格式无法在电脑上解码，未同步。可在 iPhone 上截图后复制截图，或在「照片」中将图片导出为 JPEG 后再复制
column2: This PC cannot decode the image format, so it was not synced. Take a screenshot on iPhone and copy that, or export the image as JPEG from Photos, then copy it.

column1: Windows 剪贴板被其他程序占用，未能写入。请稍后在历史中重新复制
column2: Another app is using the Windows clipboard, so it was not written. Copy it again from history later.

column1: 内容格式无效，未能写入 Windows 剪贴板。请在手机上重新复制一次
column2: The content is invalid and was not written to the Windows clipboard. Copy it again on the phone.

column1: 电脑上复制的图片过大，未发送到 iPhone。请缩小或裁剪图片后重新复制
column2: The image copied on this PC is too large and was not sent to iPhone. Resize or crop it, then copy it again.

column1: 电脑剪贴板被其他程序占用，未能读取，本次未发送。请稍后重新复制一次
column2: Another app is using the PC clipboard, so this copy was not read or sent. Copy it again in a moment.

column1: 电脑上复制的内容无法读取，本次未发送。请重新复制一次；图片可先另存为 PNG 或 JPG 再复制
column2: The content copied on this PC could not be read and was not sent. Copy it again; for an image, save it as PNG or JPG first.

column1: 发送{kind}超时：iPhone 在 20 秒内没有确认。请保持手机解锁后重试
column2: Sending {kind} timed out: the iPhone did not confirm within 20 seconds. Keep it unlocked and try again.

column1: iPhone 拒绝了这次{kind}写入。请解锁手机后重试
column2: The iPhone rejected this {kind}. Unlock the phone and try again.

column1: 发送{kind}时 iPhone 断开了连接，未发送。重新连接后请在历史中再点「发送」
column2: The iPhone disconnected while sending {kind}; it was not sent. After it reconnects, select Send again in history.

column1: 待发送的内容过多，已暂停发送。请稍后再试
column2: Too many items are waiting to be sent. Try again later.

column1: 这种内容无法发送到 iPhone，目前只支持发送文字和图片
column2: This kind of content cannot be sent to iPhone. Only text and images can be sent.

column1: iPhone 剪贴板服务没有响应，未发送{kind}。正在重新连接，连上后请在历史中再点「发送」
column2: The iPhone clipboard service is not responding, so {kind} was not sent. Reconnecting; once connected, select Send again in history.

column1: iPhone 上复制了{kind}，但设置中未开启「{kind}」同步到电脑。如需同步，请在设置的「自动同步到电脑」中勾选「{kind}」
column2: {kind} copied on iPhone, but syncing {kind} to this PC is turned off. To sync it, select {kind} under Auto-sync to PC in Settings.

column1: iPhone 上的{kind}读取超时，未同步到电脑。请在手机上重新复制一次
column2: Reading {kind} from iPhone timed out, so it was not synced. Copy it again on the phone.

column1: iPhone 复制了{kind}，但没有提供可读取的数据，未同步到电脑。请重新复制一次；仍不行可先保存到本机（如存入相册或「文件」App）后再复制
column2: {kind} was copied on iPhone, but no readable data was provided, so it was not synced. Copy it again; if that fails, save it on the phone first (to Photos or the Files app) and copy it from there.

column1: 内容
column2: content

column1: 正在发送到 iPhone…
column2: Sending to iPhone…

column1: 发送失败
column2: Send failed

column1: iPhone 上的图片读取超时，未同步到电脑。请保持手机解锁后重新复制；相册照片若存储在 iCloud，请先在「照片」中打开原图等待加载完成，或改用截图
column2: Reading the image from iPhone timed out, so it was not synced. Keep the phone unlocked and copy it again. If the photo is stored in iCloud, open it in Photos and wait for the original to load, or use a screenshot instead.

column1: 「{name}」已下载，但电脑剪贴板里已有更新的内容，为避免覆盖未放入剪贴板。需要时可在历史中复制它
column2: Downloaded {name}, but the PC clipboard already holds newer content, so it was not replaced. Copy the file from history when you need it.

column1: 「{name}」已下载，但电脑剪贴板里已有更新的内容，为避免覆盖未放入剪贴板。如仍需要，请在手机上重新复制该文件
column2: Downloaded {name}, but the PC clipboard already holds newer content, so it was not replaced. If you still need it, copy the file on the phone again.

column1: 这台 iPhone 的系统版本过低。CopiaGo 需要 iOS 17.4 或更高版本，请在 iPhone「设置 → 通用 → 软件更新」中更新后再连接。
column2: This iPhone’s iOS is too old. CopiaGo needs iOS 17.4 or later. Update it in Settings → General → Software Update on your iPhone, then connect again.

column1: 同步密码管理器复制的内容
column2: Send copies from password managers
